description: This file defines a React component for a network tab in a trace viewer, including data models, rendering logic, filtering, sorting, and related utility classes for managing network resource display within a trace analysis tool.

classes.name: ContextIdMap
classes.description: Utility class for assigning and managing context IDs for trace resources, such as pages and API requests.

methods.name: useNetworkTabModel
methods.description: Hook to create and manage the network tab's data model based on trace data and selected time boundaries.

methods.name: NetworkTab
methods.description: React component rendering the network requests table with filtering, sorting, and detailed view capabilities.

methods.name: ContextIdMap.contextId
methods.description: Retrieves a short context ID for a given resource, generating new IDs for page or API request references.

methods.name: formatRouteStatus
methods.description: Generates a string status for a network request based on its properties such as aborted, fulfilled, etc.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of network resource entries based on specified sorting criteria.

methods.name: comparator
methods.description: Returns a comparison function for sorting based on a given column.

methods.name: filterEntry
methods.description: Creates a filter predicate to filter network entries based on search value and resource type filters.
